title: Ambient tensor composition in the published sequence categories
statement: Let F be a finite-field datum, l a prime different from F.p, and E a finite extension of Q_l. For composable morphisms f:X→Y and g:Y→Z in Spaces F, and arbitrary unbounded sequence objects M,N over Z, the actual ambient sequence pullbacks and comparisons recorded in publishedSystemAmbientData satisfy Qf(mu_g);mu_f(Qg M,Qg N);T_X(b_M,b_N) = b_(T_Z(M,N));mu_(fg), where b:Qg⋙Qf≅Qfg is the recorded ambient compositor. This contains no published-comparison or Compositors identification. [def-sf-ambient-proper-open-calculus] [def-sf-published-system-ambient-presentation]

source.place: Tags 07A4 and 07A7; final sequence-site conjunct of ambientPullbackTensorCoherence, with the published system tensor models.

proof.text: Install a Fintype structure on the finite base field. Its cardinality is p^a; charP_of_card_eq_prime_pow gives characteristic p. Algebra.ringChar_eq transfers this to the algebraic closure, so l≠p supplies l≠ringChar(F.k).

The defining properties of X,Y,Z in Spaces F supply locally finite-type and quasi-compact structure maps. Apply ambientPullbackTensorCoherence with s=none and with the systemClosed structures and systemTensorModel models of pullbackTensorCalculus. Take its last conjunct and evaluate at M,N. The ambient package records exactly its pullbacks, tensor comparisons and derived compositor.

lean.statement:
theorem publishedSystemAmbientCoherence (F : WeilConjectures.FiniteFieldDatum.{u})
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ F.p)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] :
    ∀ {X Y Z : Spaces F} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
      (M N : WeilConjectures.coefficientSequenceDerived l E Z.obj.left),
      ((WeilConjectures.publishedSystemAmbientData l E).pull f.hom.left).map
          (((WeilConjectures.publishedSystemAmbientData l E).tensor g.hom.left).hom.app (M, N)) ≫
        ((WeilConjectures.publishedSystemAmbientData l E).tensor f.hom.left).hom.app
          (((WeilConjectures.publishedSystemAmbientData l E).pull g.hom.left).obj M,
            ((WeilConjectures.publishedSystemAmbientData l E).pull g.hom.left).obj N) ≫
        (WeilConjectures.pullbackTensorCalculus l E X.obj.left).systemClosed.tensor.map
          (Prod.mkHom
            (((WeilConjectures.publishedSystemAmbientData l E).comp
              f.hom.left g.hom.left).hom.app M)
            (((WeilConjectures.publishedSystemAmbientData l E).comp
              f.hom.left g.hom.left).hom.app N)) =
      ((WeilConjectures.publishedSystemAmbientData l E).comp f.hom.left g.hom.left).hom.app
          ((WeilConjectures.pullbackTensorCalculus l E Z.obj.left).systemClosed.tensor.obj (M, N)) ≫
        ((WeilConjectures.publishedSystemAmbientData l E).tensor
          (f.hom.left ≫ g.hom.left)).hom.app (M, N)
